command: cooperbench run -n coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash_10-low-delivery-timing -s flash_10 -a mini_swe_agent_v2 -m vertex_ai/gemini-3-flash-preview --agent-config configs/variants/delivery_timing_low.yaml --setting coop -c 10 --backend docker --git
agent_config:
# Variant config: Message Delivery Timing (low thinking, gemini-3-flash-preview).
# Holds non-blocking incoming messages until natural workflow boundaries (clean test/git/PR
# commands, messaging turns, or explore-to-edit transitions) or 4 steps, while delivering
# blocking (--wait) messages immediately.
# Pass via: MODEL=vertex_ai/gemini-3-flash-preview AGENT_CONFIG=configs/variants/delivery_timing_low.yaml RUN_SUFFIX=low-delivery-timing tools/run.sh coop flash_10 10 --git
agent:
  cost_limit: 40.0
  step_counter: true
  delivery_timing: true
  delivery_max_hold_steps: 4
  delivery_boundary_mode: natural

model:
  model_kwargs:
    drop_params: true
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingLevel: low
      includeThoughts: true
